Practice: Check security only before the final release
Why it can cause problems: Important problems may be found after other work depends on them
Established alternative: Provide earlier feedback and continue checks during release and operation

Practice: Share one deployment identity across environments
Why it can cause problems: A compromise can affect several projects or environments
Established alternative: Limit identities and permissions to their tasks and environments

Practice: Run changeable external scripts in privileged jobs
Why it can cause problems: Downloaded code can change without a reviewed repository change
Established alternative: Control inputs, check trusted integrity values, and separate execution

Practice: Treat every warning as equally urgent
Why it can cause problems: Missing context and repeated alerts can make prioritization difficult
Established alternative: Review relevance, assign owners, and document exceptions

Practice: Assume a signature proves software is safe
Why it can cause problems: A signature authenticates a statement or origin, not all behavior
Established alternative: Check artifact identity and production information alongside application security

Practice: Create an SBOM only for an audit
Why it can cause problems: An unused or outdated inventory does not support a timely response
Established alternative: Connect component information to deployments and vulnerability handling

Practice: Assume automation always restores secure infrastructure
Why it can cause problems: Automation can repeatedly apply an unsafe configuration
Established alternative: Review the intended settings and observe the actual environment

Practice: Treat an alert as a completed response
Why it can cause problems: The problem may remain unresolved without an owner or action
Established alternative: Maintain clear responsibilities and practical response processes
